summary: Independent review of current job 79109d9ad11413625eb0 (attachment SHA-256 6478f5af…079469 verified). I read all 9 owned units, s0020–s0028, in Chinese and checked every owned person's supplied chronology, including read-only contextItem claim-147. No birth or age is stated. The only deaths are Muti and Siluohou (s0021, 皆斬之), both recorded as AD 334. 咸和九年 is AD 334: Xianhe was Emperor Cheng's era, running from 326 until Xiankang began on the first day of 335. This is year precision only. The 旬余 and 圍守二旬 intervals keep the Liucheng fights in the same year. The s0020 backing of Ren correctly keeps a 333–334 window rather than a chosen year. hints-p010 ["AD 333-334","AD 334"] matches Duan Liao's own events. All 36 items and 10 people are supported, with no chronology omissions. Note, not a date defect: unitPeople maps 遼 in s0024 to p157, a second Duan Liao record outside this job, which identity jobs own. English: I checked the supplied en field of all 9 owned units and found no definite defect. s0028's en now renders 圍守二旬, 躬勒將士, 敗之 and 斬首千五百級 correctly. This packet supplies no literal field, so the literal translation was not checked, and repeated uses were not checked here because the host supplies them. No full chapter or publication approval is given.
